ns2:course.label: FAA Professional Development
ns2:course.description: Focuses on tailoring written, verbal, and online presentations to targeted audiences. Students will develop an application package including resume, letter, LinkedIn profile, elevator pitch, interview skills, and website. Course information: Prerequisite: Sophomore, junior or senior standing in FAA is required.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Fine & Applied Arts. Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
